part4_database module

SQLite persistence layer for the School Management System.

The Database class stores students, instructors, courses and enrollments and can convert to and from a part1_oop.School.

class part4_database.Database(path='school.db')[source]

Bases: object

SQLite backed storage for school records.

Parameters:

path (str, optional) – Path of the SQLite database file, defaults to school.db
